title: The Cholesterol That Left by Another Door — Transintestinal Cholesterol Excretion (TICE), Dual-Isotope Fecal Sterol Balance & Ezetimibe Flux

teenKit.tldr: Your body performs a daily thermodynamic miracle by forcing oil and water to mix, and scientists recently discovered a hidden backdoor route called TICE that flushes out cholesterol.
teenKit.whyItMatters: Understanding how our bodies naturally move and eliminate cholesterol is rewriting the rules of modern medicine and cardiovascular health.
keyTakeaways: Oil and water naturally repel each other, meaning your digestive system has to use brilliant biophysical engineering just to let you absorb fats without starving.
Chewing and saliva kick off a wave of mechanical and chemical violence on your food long before it hits your stomach.
TICE (Transintestinal Cholesterol Excretion) proves that the liver and bile aren't the only ways your body gets rid of cholesterol—it can pump it straight through the gut wall.

vocab.meaning: A newly understood biological pathway where cholesterol is pumped directly from the blood through the intestinal wall and out into the gut.
A fluid produced by the liver that acts like biological dish soap to help break down and digest fats in a watery environment.
A scientific method of tracking tagged molecules as they travel through the body to map out complex chemical pathways.
The movement and measurement of cholesterol transport when a specific drug blocks normal absorption pathways in the gut.

quiz.question: What fundamental physical problem does your digestive system have to solve every time you eat fat?
options: Oil and water aggressively repel each other, preventing easy mixing.
Stomach acid instantly destroys all vitamins on contact.
Teaches cannot generate enough mechanical shear force to break down lipids.
Enzymes freeze up in body temperature environments.
quiz.explanation: Because oil and water naturally separate, your body has to perform a biophysical miracle to let you absorb fats.

quiz.question: What does the discovery of TICE fundamentally change in medicine?
options: It proves that chewing is completely unnecessary for lipid digestion.
It shows that cholesterol can exit the body directly through the intestinal wall rather than just via the liver.
It demonstrates that dietary fat has zero impact on blood chemistry.
It replaces all known cholesterol-lowering medications with simple water intake.
quiz.explanation: TICE revealed an alternative backdoor exit route for cholesterol straight through the gut lining.

quiz.question: What role does mastication play in the process of lipid digestion?
options: It chemically neutralizes stomach acid before food arrives.
It applies immense mechanical shear force to crush the biological matrix of the food.
It instantly converts cholesterol into pure protein.
It freezes fats so they can be absorbed as solids.
quiz.explanation: Chewing physically breaks down the food's structure, launching the complex process of digestion.
